title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of novel napabucasin-melatonin hybrids as potent STAT3 inhibitors.
authors: Zhang, Chong; Yang, Limin; Yang, Xiaojuan; Gao, Qinghe; Qu, Yan; Wu, Liqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成napabucasin-褪黑素杂合体作为STAT3抑制剂，通过荧光偏振和分子对接研究小分子与STAT3 SH2域结合，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅含分子对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The current work developed diverse novel napabucasin-melatonin hybrids as potent STAT3 inhibitors. Several biological studies have suggested many compounds demonstrating potent inhibition against different tumor cells. Among these, compound 7e depicted enhanced inhibition against HepG2, MDA-MB-231, and A549 cells than napabucasin, with IC(50) values of 1.06, 1.38, and 1.3 microM, respectively. Based on fluorescence polarization analysis, compound 7e was bound to the SH2 domain in STAT3, with an IC(50) value of 12.95 microM. Molecular docking further confirmed the 7e binding mode inside the SH2 domain of STAT3. Further mechanistic studies indicated that 7e inhibited the activation of STAT3 (Y705), and thus reduced the expression of STAT3 downstream genes (CyclinD1, Bcl-2 and c-Myc) instead of affecting p-STAT1 expression. Meanwhile, the phosphorylation levels of its upstream kinases JAK2 and bypass kinase Erk1/2 remain unaffected. Simultaneously, 7e induced cancer cell apoptosis in a concentration-dependent manner. Significantly, 20 mg/kg (i.p.) compound 7e suppressed the mouse HepG2 xenograft development in vivo without body weight loss, suggesting that it could be an effective antitumor agent.
abstract_zh: 本研究开发了多种新型的napabucasin-褪黑素杂交体，作为强效的STAT3抑制剂。多项生物学研究表明，许多化合物对不同肿瘤细胞表现出强效抑制作用。其中，化合物7e对HepG2、MDA-MB-231和A549细胞的抑制作用优于napabucasin，其IC(50)值分别为1.06、1.38和1.3微摩尔。基于荧光偏振分析，化合物7e与STAT3的SH2结构域结合，IC(50)值为12.95微摩尔。分子对接进一步确认了7e在STAT3 SH2结构域内的结合模式。进一步的机制研究表明，7e抑制了STAT3（Y705）的激活，从而降低了STAT3下游基因（CyclinD1、Bcl-2和c-Myc）的表达，而不影响p-STAT1的表达。同时，其上游激酶JAK2和旁路激酶Erk1/2的磷酸化水平保持不变。此外，7e以浓度依赖性方式诱导癌细胞凋亡。值得注意的是，20 mg/kg（腹腔注射）的化合物7e在体内抑制了小鼠HepG2异种移植瘤的生长，且未导致体重下降，表明其可能是一种有效的抗肿瘤药物。
